phase_history.details: Designed 14 tests across 5 test classes for chunk-10
All 5 invariants verified (inv-10-01 through inv-10-05). Note: inv-10-02/04 -k filters need CamelCase (StrategyRouting, Semaphore) not snake_case.
ruff format + ruff check passing. 257/257 PTC tests pass (no regressions).

deviations.description: Plan's invariant -k filters use snake_case (strategy_routing, semaphore) but test classes use CamelCase (TestStrategyRouting, TestSemaphoreBackpressure). Used CamelCase filters for verification.
deviations.reason: Python convention for class names is CamelCase. pytest -k is substring-based, underscore vs no-underscore matters.
deviations.plan_gap: Plan invariant commands assumed snake_case -k filters would match CamelCase class names
deviations.impact: Low - tests still pass, just need correct -k filter string

decisions_made.decision: Used real event_logger API signatures (log_tool_call_complete takes 6 args: exec_id, call_id, tool, duration_ms, result_bytes, result_preview) rather than simplified design doc version (4 args)
decisions_made.reason: Design doc simplified the API. Real event_logger.py has richer signatures. Adapting to real API avoids integration issues.

decisions_made.decision: Generated call_id per dispatch via uuid for event logger tracking
decisions_made.reason: Event logger methods require call_id parameter. Dispatcher generates one per dispatch call.

decisions_made.decision: Used asyncio.run_in_executor for subprocess_dispatch and host_network_dispatch
decisions_made.reason: ptc_tools testing/git/network functions are blocking (subprocess.run, urllib). Wrapping in executor prevents event loop blocking.
